newsitem.title: FINLAND: IVO SEES ACQUISITIONS BOOSTING 1997 NET SALES.
newsitem.headline: IVO SEES ACQUISITIONS BOOSTING 1997 NET SALES.

text.p: Finnish state-owned power group Imatran Voima Oy (IVO) said on Friday it expects recent acquisitions to boost group net sales by a few billions of markka in 1997 from about 12 billion markka estimated for 1996.
"Net sales will be few billion markka higher next year than this year," IVO CEO Kalevi Numminen told a news conference.

Numminen said Finnish utility Lansivoima Oy and Swedish power producer Gullspang will be fully consolidated in IVO's 1997 profit and loss accounts, and this would more than offset the decreasing impact from the agreed sale of IVO's national grid.
